edges.name: same-origin links · depth 1
edges.description: Follows links that remain on the source page's exact scheme, host, and port; bounded to 100 candidates per source page in document order.
edges.sql:

FROM edge.page_links

  AND relation_kind IN ('same_url', 'same_path', 'same_origin')
ORDER BY element_index

description: Recursively follow unseen same-site URLs with a non-empty query string. Useful for pagination and faceted catalogues; always use a conservative maximum crawl budget.

nodes.name: root
nodes.description: Receives roots and recursively acquires query-bearing same-site destinations.

edges.name: same-site query links · recursive
edges.description: Recursively follows up to 50 unseen same-site query URLs per source page; graph-wide URL deduplication bounds repeated discoveries.
edges.sql:
SELECT target_url AS url
FROM edge.page_links
WHERE crawl_id = $crawl_id
  AND relation_kind <> 'external' AND target_query IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY element_index
LIMIT 50
